name: Preserve meaningful loading for strength-focused movements
description: ACSM recommends heavier loading around 80% 1RM and multiple sets when strength is the primary outcome.
explanation: Strength-focused movements should preserve meaningful loading even during a fat-loss phase, unless recovery/local readiness argues otherwise.

name: Failure is not required for adaptation
description: ACSM's 2026 review reports that momentary muscular failure is not consistently necessary for results in healthy adults.
explanation: Do not require training to failure; use RIR/RPE-style effort targets alongside progressive overload.

name: Lean-cut goal preserves strength/lean mass rather than maximizing volume
description: For a fat-loss-with-lean-mass-preservation goal, the primary training objective is to preserve or improve strength and lean mass while body fat declines.
explanation: A cut must not turn primarily into cardio; body-composition and performance trends should be used to detect possible under-recovery.
